run.question: b4-demo 这个 namespace 最近一次发布是什么时候

report.summary: The b4-demo namespace has exactly one Helm release, "web" (chart web-0.1.0, app_version 1.16.0). Its most recent release action was revision 3, last_deployed 2026-11-20T21:39:21Z, and it failed: Helm recorded 'Upgrade "web" failed: resource Deployment/b4-demo/web not ready. status: InProgress, message: Pending termination: 1 context deadline exceeded'. The same release cycle's earlier steps were revision 1 (install, 21:39:15Z) and revision 2 (upgrade complete, 21:39:16Z, still the deployed revision). The failed revision 3 corresponds to Deployment b4-demo/web (helm annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=3) whose pod template now carries the image tag nginx:does-not-exist-b4; the replica created for it, pod web-d59578599-m8mlm, is Pending with ImagePullBackOff because that tag does not resolve (NotFound). So the last release activity in the namespace is the failed revision 3 at 2026-11-20T21:39:21Z, roughly 2 minutes before this evidence was gathered.

claims.text: Namespace b4-demo contains one Helm release named "web" (chart web 0.1.0, app_version 1.16.0); its latest revision is 3 with last_deployed 2026-11-20T21:39:21Z, first_deployed 2026-11-20T21:39:15Z and status "failed".

Helm history of release web in b4-demo has 3 revisions: revision 1 "Install complete" last_deployed 2026-11-20T21:39:15Z (superseded), revision 2 "Upgrade complete" last_deployed 2026-11-20T21:39:16Z (status deployed), revision 3 last_deployed 2026-11-20T21:39:21Z with status failed and description 'Upgrade "web" failed: resource Deployment/b4-demo/web not ready. status: InProgress, message: Pending termination: 1 context deadline exceeded'.
Deployment b4-demo/web was created 2026-11-20T21:39:15Z, carries meta.helm.sh/release-name=web and deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=3, and its current pod template image is nginx:does-not-exist-b4.

Two pods exist in b4-demo: web-b77b9fdb5-gj4jq (Running, container ready=true, started 2026-11-20T21:39:16Z) and web-d59578599-m8mlm (Pending, ready=false, container waiting reason ImagePullBackOff, started 2026-11-20T21:39:21Z).

Events for pod web-d59578599-m8mlm (21:39:22Z to 21:40:54Z) show 'Pulling image "nginx:does-not-exist-b4"' then Warning Failed 'Failed to pull image "nginx:does-not-exist-b4": rpc error: code = NotFound ... failed to resolve reference' and 'Error: ErrImagePull'; the same window shows pod web-b77b9fdb5-gj4jq successfully pulling nginx:1.27.4 at 21:39:20Z.

Three ReplicaSets owned by Deployment web exist in b4-demo: web-685fcc95d4 (created 2026-11-20T21:39:15Z), web-b77b9fdb5 (21:39:16Z) and web-d59578599 (21:39:21Z); Deployment events show scale-up of web-685fcc95d4 at 21:39:15Z, scale-up of web-b77b9fdb5 at 21:39:16Z, and at 21:39:21Z scale-down of web-685fcc95d4 to 0 together with scale-up of web-d59578599 to 1.

The failed revision 3 at 2026-11-20T21:39:21Z failed because its pod template pins the non-existent tag nginx:does-not-exist-b4, so the replica web-d59578599-m8mlm could never pull and the Deployment stayed InProgress past Helm's deadline. The exact prior image was nginx:1.27.4 (pulled successfully by web-b77b9fdb5-gj4jq).

The transient Warning Unhealthy readiness-probe misses on startup pods (connection refused on port 80 at 21:39:15Z and 21:39:20Z) do not explain the revision-3 failure: that pod failed before starting a container, with ErrImagePull/NotFound on nginx:does-not-exist-b4, and the other pod reached Running/ready.

Check the release values/source that supplied the image tag nginx:does-not-exist-b4 for release web (chart values and the rendered manifest are not exposed by the Helm tools), and consider rolling release web back to revision 2, whose pods run nginx:1.27.4.

gaps: Helm chart values and the rendered manifest are not returned by the Helm tools, so what set the image tag nginx:does-not-exist-b4 and who applied revision 3 (CI/CD vs manual helm upgrade) could not be verified.

2 events in b4-demo were dropped as outside the authorized window, so anything that happened before 2026-11-19T21:41:24Z in this namespace is unknown; all Helm revisions observed start at 2026-11-20T21:39:15Z.
next_steps: Review the pipeline or values file that produced revision 3 of release web in namespace b4-demo and correct the image tag.
If the bad tag cannot be corrected promptly, evaluate a Helm rollback of release web to revision 2 (nginx:1.27.4).

view.cannot_prove: Release history is the current content of Helm's records: revisions outside the authorized window are listed too, so it cannot prove that only these changes happened inside the window. Only Helm's own record: changes made with kubectl apply or kubectl edit, or by any tool other than Helm, are not in it. Revision times come from Helm, not from when Pods finished rolling out; deployed only means Helm considered the release successful, not that its Pods are healthy.
